name: Developers lack data-driven guidance for right-sizing container requests
description: Developers, accustomed to large VMs, are defaulting to oversized resource requests in the new containerized platform. This happens because they lack clear, data-backed guidance on how to determine appropriate CPU and memory limits, leading to systemic waste and undermining the platform's efficiency goals.
evidence: So the problem is that the developers don't know what to ask for. They're used to getting a VM, it has 4 vCPU and 16 gigs of RAM, so they ask for 4 vCPU and 16 gigs of RAM.
We need to give them some sort of guidance, right? Some sort of data that says, 'Hey, your application is using this much, you should probably ask for this much.'
